NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 11th July, 2023 


8.0. 3088(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road 
Transport and Highways, 961 Dated:01/03/2023, 1476 Dated:28/03/2023 , published in the Gazette of 
India, Extraordinary, Part I, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the 
National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government 
declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for 
building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of NH754A in the stretch of 
land from Km. 14.1 to Km. 30.25 (District Revenue Officer Jalandhar) in the district of JALANDHAR in 
the state of PUNJAB 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “TIMES OF INDIA & 
THE INDIAN EXPRESS” and “PUNJABI JAGRAN & PUNJABI JAGRAN” both dated 01/03/2023 & 
14/04/2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by 
the competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority 
has submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the 
powers conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that the land specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government 
hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said 
Schedule shall vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

New Delhi, the 11th July, 2023 


S.O. 3072(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 


[भाग 1---खण्ड 3(ii)] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण 15 


the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for 
construction (widening/four lane with paved shoulder etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of Raebareli 
Ring Road Phase-II in the stretch of land from Km. 0.000 to Km. 21.888 of Phase-II in the district of RAEBARELI in 
the state of UTTAR PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Special land acquisition 
officer(Joint organization), Raebareli in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority 
shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing 
all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by 
order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 
The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 


inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

New Delhi, the |th July, 2023 


S.O. 302(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, !403 (E) Dated:23/03/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for Widening and upgradation to 2-Lane/4-Lane with paved shoulders of Kangar & 
Rampura Phul Bypass road section of NH254 in the stretch of land from Km. 5!.200 to Km. 80.60 (except km 
56.240 to km 70.500) SDM cum CALA , Rampura Phul (Sub Divisional Administrative Complex,Rampura Phul) in 
the district of BATHINDA in the state of PUNJAB. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Tribune”(English) and 
“Jagbani” (Punjabi) both dated 29-03-2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disposed of by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


[भाग ave 3(ii)] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण 97 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 1637(अ) दिनांक 05 अप्रैल, 2023, जो भारत के राजपत्र 
सं. 1558 दिनांक 05 अप्रैल, 2023, असाधारण, भाग ॥, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा तमिलनाडु 
राज्य के मदुरै जिले में एनएच-49 एक्सटेंशन (नया एनएच -85) के किमी 6.6 से 10.4 तक अचमपथु, विराटिपथु बाईपास 
का निर्माण तक के भूखण्ड पर निर्माण, अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में 
विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "25 अप्रैल 2023 
" को "दिनाकरन" और "टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 
है; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी |

New Delhi, the 11th July, 2023 


S.O. 3080(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of Greenfield 
Highway in the stretch of land from Km. 46.6 to Km. 55.037 (District Office, Karnal) in the district of KARNAL in 
the State of HARYANA, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section (1) of 


section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, DISTRICT REVENUE OFFICER, 
KARNAL in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 


disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 


final.

S.O. 307(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, number S.O. No. 3593 (E) Dated 0.08.2022, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, 
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (Six/Eight-laning etc.), maintenance management and 
operation of National Highway, in the stretch of land for newly proposed Ahmednagar - Solapur - Akkalkot- MH/KN 
Border (Including Spur Connectivity to Solapur Town) Greenfield alignment from Km. 370/000 to Km. 488/000 
(Maharashtra Section) in Osmanabad District in the State of Maharashtra; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Lokmat (Marathi)" and “Daily 
Indian Express (English)” both dated 09.08.2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


[भाग are 3(ii)] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण 3 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

असाधारण, भाग I, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) F प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा बिहार राज्य के रोहतास जिले में ग्रीनफिल्ड हाईवे 
के कि.मी. 74 से PAT. 07 तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ा करने/चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन 
और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की 
थी; 

और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "3-08-2022" 
को "टाइम्स आंफ इंडिया" और "दैनिक जागरण" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 
है; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (॥) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की STAT (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the lth July, 2023 


S.O. 306(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 3357 Dated:22/07/2022 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section 
(ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed 
to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of 
Greenfield Highway in the stretch of land from Km. 74 to Km. !0! in the district of ROHTAS in the state of BIHAR; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Jagran” and “Times of 
India” both dated 3-08-2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 3104(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 5326 (अ) तारीख 16/11/2022, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग 11 खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य के करनूल जिले में राष्ट्रीय 
राजमार्ग 167 के कि.मी. 62.700 से कि.मी.70.000 (अडोनी बायपास टाउन) तक के भूखण्ड पर के निर्माण, 
(चौड़ीकरण/पेग्ड शोल्डर सहित 2-लेन/4-लेन का बनाना आदि ), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना 
से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "08.12.2022 " 
को "हंस इंडिया" और "आंध्र प्रभा" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर 
दिया है; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को 
अपनी रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


4492 GI/2023 (1) 


2 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 

और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है 
कि इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक 
रूप से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी । 

अनुसूची

वाली संरचना सहित अथवा संरचना रहित विवरण।

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 11th July, 2023 


S.O. 3104(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 5326 (E) Dated:16/11/2022 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, 
Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,) of 
Maintenance, management and operation of NH167 in the stretch of land from Km. 62.700 to Km. 70.000 (Adoni 
Byepass Town) in the district of KURNOOL in the state of ANDHRA PRADESH ;

prabha” both dated 08.12.2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 3103(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 4620 तारीख 30/09/2022, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग I, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) F प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा हरियाणा राज्य के यमुनानगर जिले में 
Greenfield Highway के कि.मी. 55.037 से कि.मी.71.168 (जिला कार्यालय, यमुना नगर) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के 
निर्माण (चौड़ा करने/चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध 
अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "टाइम्स ऑफ 
इंडिया" को "अर्थ प्रकाश" और "15-10-2022" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर 
दिया है ; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को 
अपनी रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


4491 GI/2023 (1) 


2 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 

और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है 
कि इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक 
रूप से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी । 

अनुसूची

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 11th July, 2023 


S.O. 3103(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 4620 Dated:30/09/2022 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, 
Sub-section (1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of Greenfield Highway in the stretch of land from Km. 55.037 to Km. 71.168 (DISTRICT Office, 
YAMUNA NAGAR) in the district of YAMUNANAGAR in the state of HARYANA; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “7JIMES OF INDIA” and “ARTH 
PARKASH” both dated /5-10.2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

New Delhi, the | lth July, 2023 


S.O. 3098(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, $.0.!753 (E) dated !7th April, 2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 
3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of Newly Proposed (NH-205AG) on the stretch of land (Sarhind Fatehgarh Sahib - Sehna Barnala) from Km 
0 to Km 27.355 in the district of Fatehgarh Sahib in the state of PUNJAB 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Indian Express (English) and 
Punjabi Jagran (Punjabi) ” both dated 22.04.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

पाइपलाइन के माध्यम से प्राकृतिक गैस के परिवहन के लिए पाइपलाइन बिछाने के प्रयोजन के लिए उपयोग के अधिकार 
का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी; 


और उक्त राजपत्र अधिसूचना की प्रतियां जनता को उपलब्ध करा दी गई थी; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 6 की उपधारा () के अधीन भारत सरकार को अपनी रिपोर्ट 
दे दी है; 


और भारत सरकार ने, उक्त रिपोर्ट पर विचार करने के पश्चात्‌ और यह संतुष्ट हो जाने पर कि उक्त भूमि 
पाइपलाइन बिछाने के लिए अपेक्षित है, उसमें उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन करने का विनिश्चय किया है;

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 28th June, 2023 
S.O. 30(E).— Whereas by notification of Government of India in the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural 
Gas S.O. No.I324(E), 020(E), 373(E), 230I(E) and 787(E) dated 6.03.2023, 27.02.2023, 22.03.2022, 3.05.2022 
and 06.04.2022 issued under sub- section (.) of Section 3 of the Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines (Acquisition of 
Right of User in Land) Act, !962 (50 of 962) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), published in the Extra Ordinary 
Gazette of India dated 2!.03.2023, 02.03.2023, 25.03.2022, 8.05.2022 and 2.04.2022 the Government of India 
declared its intention to acquire the Right of User in the land specified in the Schedule appended to that notification 


for the purpose of laying pipeline for transportation of natural gas through Nagpur — Jabalpur Pipeline section of 
Mumbai - Nagpur — Jharsuguda Pipeline Project in the State of Madhya Pradesh by GAIL (India) Limited; 


And whereas copies of the said Gazette notification were made available to the public; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has, under sub-section (l) of Section 6 of the said Act, submitted its 
report to Government of India; 


And whereas Government of India after considering the said report and on being satisfied that the said land is 
required for laying the pipeline, has decided to acquire the Right of User therein; 


Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (l) of section 6 of the said Act, 
Government of India hereby declares that the Right of User in the land specified in the Schedule appended to this 
notification is hereby acquired for laying the pipeline; 


And, further, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (4) of Section 6 of the said Act, Government 
of India hereby directs that the Right of User in the land for laying the pipeline shall, instead of vesting in Government 
of India, vest, on this date of the publication of the declaration, in the GAIL (India) Limited, free from all 
encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 11th July, 2023 


S.O. 3101(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 2022 Dated:02/05/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH-334G in the stretch of land from Km. 41.75 to Km. 55.92 (Development of six lane access control greenfield 
highway of Delhi-SaharanpurDehradun economic corridor) in the district of MUZAFFARNAGAR in the state of 
UTTAR PRADESH; 

And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Hindustan” and “Hindustan 
Times” both dated 10.05.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 5823(अ) दिनांक 13 दिसंबर, 2022, जो भारत के 
राजपत्र सं. 5587 दिनांक 13 दिसंबर, 2022, असाधारण, भाग I, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा 
तमिलनाडु राज्य के तिरुपथुर जिले में एनएच-179 ए के सेलम तिरुपथुर-वनियामबाड़ी रोड के किमी 80/0 से किमी 
125/0 तक कैरिजवे को मजबूत करने सहित मौजूदा 2 लेन को 4 लेन Gos शोल्डर तक चौड़ीकरण तक के भूखण्ड पर 
निर्माण, अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के 
अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "24 दिसंबर, 
2022 " को "डेली तांथी" और "टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 
है; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ;

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 11th July, 2023 


S.O. 3091(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, S.O. 5823(E) Dated:13th December, 2022 , published in the Gazette of India No. 5587 Dated: 
13th December, 2022 , Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of 
the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government 
declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for Widening of 
existing 2 lane to 4 lane with paved shoulder including strengthening of carriageway from Km 80/0-Km 125/0 of 
Salem Tirupathur - Vaniyambadi Road of NH-179A in the district of TIRUPATHUR in the state of TAMIL NADU 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Daily Tanthi” and “Times of India” 
both dated 24th December, 2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the th July, 2023 


9.0. 3097(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.O. 559(E) Dated:03/02/2023, S.0.207I(E) Dated:03/05/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, 
Extraordinary, Part I, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highway 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to 
acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), 
maintenance, management and operation of NH344B on the stretch of land from Km 0 to Km 6.3 of Phagwara 
Hoshiarpur Section including Hoshiarpur Bypass in the district of KAPURTHALA in the state of PUNJAB 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Hindustan Times” and “Ajit” both 
dated "08.02.2023" & “Hindustan Times” and “Ajit” both dated "09.05.2023"; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of 
the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 3842(अ), तारीख 16 अगस्त, 2022, जो भारत के

के वैशाली जिले में राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग संख्या-19 के कि.मी. 207.200 से कि.मी. 214.615 तक के भू-खण्ड (रामअशीष

है;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 11th July, 2023 


S.O. 3096(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, number S.O.- 3842(E), dated the 16 August, 2022, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, 
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) on 16 August, 2022 and issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National 
Highways Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its 
intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (Constuction of 
new bridge with approaches parallel to existing 4-Lane MG Setu), maintenance, management and operation of 
National Highway No.- 19, in the stretch of land from Km 207.200 to Km. 214.615 (Ramashish Chowk Hajipur, 
Vaishali Km. 207.200 to Zero mile, Patna Km. 221.700) in District of Vaishali in the state of BIHAR; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Hindustan” and " Prabhat Khabar" 


dated 24.10.2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 


competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 


submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 


specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 


vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

हो जाने के पश्चात्‌ कि आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य के पलनाडु जिले में राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग167ए के कि.मी. 35+200 से कि.मी.81.690 
(वोडरेवु -चिलकालूरिपेट - नरसरायपेट - नकारिकललू सेक्शन ) तक के भू-खण्ड के निर्माण (चौड़ीकरण/पेव्ड शोल्डर 
सहित 2-लेन/4-लेन का बनाना आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है 
जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है, ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है | 


कोई भी व्यक्ति, जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ग की उप-धारा (1) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा। 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी, अर्थात्‌ जॉइंट कलेक्टर , पालनाडु को लिखित रूप मे प्रस्तुत की जाएगी 
और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी, आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप मे या किसी विधिक 
पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात्‌ तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने के पश्चात्‌, यदि 
कोई हो, जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे, आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को अनुज्ञात कर सकेगा या अननुज्ञात कर 
सकेगा |

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 13th July, 2023 


8.0. 3127(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National 
Highways Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after 
being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule 
below, is required for building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, 
management and operation of NHI167A in the stretch of land from Km. 35+200 to Km. 814690 
(Vodarevu-Chilakaluripet- Narasaraopet- Nakarikallu Section) in the district of Palnadu in the state of 
ANDHRA PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of 
this notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub- 
section(1) of section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Joint Collector, Palnadu 
in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such 
objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by 
order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act 
shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of land covered under this notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority

का.आ. 3105(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 968 की तारीख 01/03/2023, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा पंजाब राज्य के फाजिल्का जिले में राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग 
7 के कि.मी. 70 से कि.मी. 50 तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ा करने/चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, 
प्रबंधत और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की 
घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "12.03.2023 " 
को " ट्रिब्यून इंग्लिश" और "पंजाबी ट्रिब्यून " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

और AAT प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 
है; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 11th July, 2023 


9.0. 3105(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.0.968(E), dated 01/03/2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, 
Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH7 in the stretch of land from Km. 70 to Km. 50 in the district of Fazilka in the state of Punjab 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Tribune English” and 
“Punjabi_Tribune ” both dated 12/03/2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority or Sub Divisional Officer Abohar; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.
